verdict.rationale: Navan, a SaaS travel and expense platform, documents an official MCP server at developer.navan.com/mcp/. It lets AI assistants such as Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT and Codex query spend, policy, approval and card data in natural language, and a probe confirmed both the MCP docs page and an llms.txt describing it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works, MCP-specific setup and authentication details, and clarity on whether write actions are supported beyond querying.
